replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: Glad you folks like it!. Yes Iron is much harder to find, it it mixed in with the diamond and some in chests, about 1 iron for every 50 diamond on the map. Enough for everyone, but like Vlad said, you got to go hunt a little, and then there is wood that is needed, so you got to go get that. - Remember the main thing is not only getting diamonds, but getting your armor enchanted to a great level. The map has enough books so you can craft a few book cases, if you find them, but you need to keep mining diamonds for the exp to enchant with, everyone should strive for level 8-10 enchants on all of their items, to be really prepared for battle. Then , you need potions correct? - lots in chests, but no brew stand, so you cant craft potions you must find them/ the map is 49 blocks deep below the diamond vein, so to make it less tragic and more fun, you will find 6 chests at start that contain leather boots with feather falling 4, you will have about 1.5 hearts if you fall from that height. but don't forget there is a castle/tower thing to explore and a giant cave that is carved out. each have secret compartments, hidden weapons and passages,  ( not shown ). The map has a few epic items... so good luck finding them . The map does have a strength potion 2 hidden, so that is something great to find too. Also, most chest have golden apples in them, as this will help the fight keep going. Books are also hidden that have Protection III, or other nice defensive enchants. I don't want people to be 1-2 hit and the match over, if you do the work, find the loot, mine to get diamonds and exp, you could be really geared up for battle. The terrain is also very PVP friendly, so lots of places for great battles. I will also try to add some better photos when I finish it today. Thoughts?

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
The map is finished here are more pics :http://imgur.com/a/viQqI

Thanks Itaity!

As for the Fully enchanted str two guy - everyone will be fully enchanted, and str two last like 1:30sec, so wold the person having the str 2 be strong for a very limited time -  I guess - but its a big map, and without a brew stand no one is going have 8:00 min str like  on other maps ( or str 2 x 3  lol  ( like garden ), also there are no Notch apples, or anything over powering to make anyone that would have strength un-kill-able.

I also made this map for the new players , super easy to get full enchanted diamond ( still takes some work tho ), run around and get chest for potions and power ups and maybe a cool named item, Base building and skybase could be cool, you can still dig and hide etc, explore the castle and find the hidden stuff or whatever... the compass will point you in the direction of someone, but they could be on any level.... all in all, it played really well for me and some friends and I hope Avicus will accept it :)  I will release the YML and map later today I hope :)

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: Volt - take a close look at the diamond vein - you can see Iron in it.... So you should have no trouble finding the iron or getting  equipped to fight. as for everyone getting diamond Armor - whats not fun about that? is it more fun to be on maps where there are only enough diamonds for 1 player to find unless they hack? no fun at all... this way, everyone could be on an even playing field and engaged in a unique map. When I post the map, download it and you will like it I am sure. Remember I am a walls player, and hate it when team mates cant get geared, or the game play is out the door. The game play is here in spades.
